paragraphs: R. Chiyya, son of Rav Kahana. In Sheerit Yosef: Rav Chiyya bar Kahana, student of Rav. See Chizkiyah above. But I have not found mention of him in the Talmud. Perhaps Sheerit Yosef has a scribal error and should read Rav Chinena bar Kahana, who spoke in Rav's name. Evidence for this is that Sheerit Yosef did not mention R. Chinena bar Kahana among Rav's students.
